authority: Evidence only; apply docs/canon/SUPERSESSIONS.md before use.

cells: Only current/correct information is included. Superseded wording and obsolete alternatives are removed from the active source.
72 encounter-enabled areas × 2 phases = 144 complete encounter tables; 6 weighted slots per table.
Mortal world and Primeval Reach use DAY / NIGHT. Hell and Reordered Underworld use mechanically identical PALE / DARK phases.
10 real-time minutes per phase; active table is chosen when an encounter begins.
Authored per location; never dynamically scaled to the player's party.
LOW ≈ 6%, NORMAL ≈ 10%, HIGH ≈ 14% per eligible step. Exact engine frequency may be tuned without changing composition.
Suppress if generated wild level ≤ first living party Abyssal level − 5. Do not reroll repeatedly for a stronger result.
No random encounters in safe settlements, rest/shop/dialogue thresholds, active puzzle interactions or cleared boss arenas.
Starters, Watchers, box legends and mythics are never normal random encounters. Fossils use main-game restoration and postgame Primeval wild populations.
Chosen branch is obtained through story evolution. The unchosen final is supplied postgame by a Primeval Reach resolver slot; story history is never rewritten.
First Emmara Mill revelation has no random encounters; its table is revisit-only.
Encounters are enabled, removing the earlier unresolved optionality.
Use Encounter Tables as the runtime ledger. Validation must stay all OK after any future balance edit.
